subject: Request: exceptional contribution top-up & long-service award — Sanjay Rao

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Compass People Ops <compass-peopleops@compass-hr.example.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Request: exceptional contribution top-up & long-service award — Sanjay Rao
Attachments: manager_rationale.docx; performance_summary.pdf

Hi People Ops —

Requesting an out-of-cycle exception for Sanjay Rao (Sr. ML Engineer, Eng Infra) for two items: a one-time performance top-up and a small equity refresh. Summary: 
- One-time cash top-up: $5,000 (taxable)
- Equity refresh: 0.05% additional RSU target, to be added to next grant cycle with pro-rated vesting to align with current grants
- Effective date requested: July 15, 2026

Rationale (manager summary): Sanjay led the recent caching/kernel optimization work that reduced inference tail latency by ~28% for the hosted fleet. Deliverable drove measurable cost savings and unlocked a large customer renewal (see performance_summary.pdf). He’s also reached 6 years at Redwood this month — we’d like to combine an exceptional contribution top-up with a modest long-service equity refresh.

Why out-of-cycle: His last formal review / refresh was 8 months ago during a role transition; this contribution is material and time-sensitive (customer renewal linked). I’ve attached a short manager rationale and performance summary.

Budget & approvals: budget code ENG-OPS-2345. Vivek is aware and supportive; requesting Laura’s leadership sign-off and HR/payroll processing. Please advise on required forms and whether we can process the cash top-up on the July payroll (deadline July 10 for July 15 payment).

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Engineering Management
Redwood Inference
From: Compass People Ops <compass-peopleops@compass-hr.example.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: exceptional contribution top-up & long-service award — Sanjay Rao

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the details and attachments. Can you confirm the following so we can route for approval quickly: 
1) Final approved cash amount and whether it’s one-time or recurring (you listed $5,000 — confirm).
2) Equity instrument (RSU vs. option) and proposed vesting schedule for the 0.05%.
3) Confirmation that the manager (Vivek) and budget owner (ENG-OPS-2345) sign off — an explicit reply from Vivek will suffice.
4) Please complete the attached Exception Request Form and return signed (we can accept a scanned signature).

We can process cash payments if we receive completed paperwork by EOD 2026-07-07 to hit the July 15 payroll. Equity changes require Comp/Legal sign-off which can take 3–5 business days. If you want us to prepare a DocuSign route, let us know.

Attached: exception_request_form.pdf (fill and return)

— Compass People Ops
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Compass People Ops <compass-peopleops@compass-hr.example.com>

Date: 2026-07-01T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: exceptional contribution top-up & long-service award — Sanjay Rao

Hi — quick answers inline: 
1) Cash: confirmed one-time $5,000 top-up.
2) Equity: RSU grant, 0.05% target (rounded), vesting pro-rated to match Sanjay’s existing schedule (4-year, 25/75 cliff-and-monthly thereafter) — ask Comp/Legal to note pro-rating to next grant date.
3) Budget owner: Vivek — he’s on-copy and confirms budget availability (see his reply).
4) Attached: completed exception_request_form.pdf (scanned signature included).

Forwarding completed form and manager_rationale.docx. Please route to Compensation & Legal for equity sign-off and to BrightPay for cash processing.

Tessa
